activity_b.text: Good morning, Apex Stationery Supplies.
This is Nadeesha speaking.
Good morning.
This is Kamal calling from the Sri Lanka–German Training Institute.
I’m calling to check the availability of several stationery items before finalising an order.
Certainly, sir.
What would you like to check first?
Could you tell me if you currently have A4 copier paper in stock, preferably in high-quality 80 gsm packs?
Yes, we do.
We have more than one hundred reams available at the moment.
That’s good.
And are these supplied in sealed five-ream cartons?
Yes, they are.
Great.
I’d also like to ask about ballpoint pens.
Are blue and black medium-tip pens available in boxes of fifty?
Yes, both colours are available.
We are restocking this morning, so the supply is stable.
Excellent.
Now, about printer ink—do you have standard black cartridges compatible with HP laser printers MFP 1188a?
Black cartridges are available, but colour cartridges are limited right now.
A new shipment is arriving early next week.
That’s fine.
We might only include black ink in this order.
What about the heavy-duty metal staples, sold in bulk boxes?
Yes, those are in stock.
And how about transparent polypropylene file folders?
Are they still available in packs of twenty?
Yes, they are, but quantities are moving quickly.
Understood.
I’m noting everything down while we’re speaking.
Some items might be adjusted once departments confirm their requirements.
No problem at all.
Once I complete that check, I’m going to prepare the final list.
Would you prefer me to email the order with exact quantities or send it by WhatsApp?
Email would be better.
WhatsApp messages tend to disappear after a while.
Emailing the order helps us reconfirm availability and prepare pricing accurately.
Alright.
I’ll email the complete order later this afternoon.
Perfect.
We’ll respond as soon as we receive it.
Thank you for your assistance.
You’re very welcome.
